editions.title: Friday Brings Sales, Free Hours And A Router Under Pressure
editions.standfirst: Terry (PC, Steam Deck, master race, full price on day one) and Reggie (PS5, saving for a Pro, waiting for the sale) read through the latest gaming news and argue about every bit of it. Everything in big type is made up, and so is the arguing. Everything in the boxes is real.

stories.headline: Console Tidies Your Desktop Without Asking; Settings Menu Becomes Hero Of The Day
stories.satire: Terry says his desktop is a curated gallery and would never accept a background it did not choose, then admits he has changed his wallpaper four times since breakfast. Reggie says he has a free one, uninvited, and is treating it like a gift from a distant uncle. They argued over whether a background you did not pick still counts as yours. Reggie wins, on account of not having paid for it.
stories.real: Pure Xbox reports that some Xbox users were shown a default GTA 6 event background without choosing it, and that it can be switched off in Settings by unticking the option for event-themed backgrounds. A Halo: Campaign Evolved background was added the same day.

stories.headline: Eight Games Wave Goodbye At The End Of The Month; Discount Stickers Brought To The Platform
stories.satire: Reggie is at the door with a clipboard, announcing the sale price before the games have even left the building, and sends Terry an imaginary invoice for waiting. Terry says a true master of the PC would have bought them all on day one and given them a farewell party. Reggie asks how many parties Terry has had. Terry counts on his fingers and runs out of fingers, then of confidence. Reggie wins on points and patience.
stories.real: Pure Xbox reports that eight games leave Xbox Game Pass on 30 November, including Aliens: Dark Descent, Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden, Moving Out 2 and Totally Reliable Delivery Service, and that most should be discounted by at least 20% over the next few weeks.

stories.headline: Retro Game Arrives With A Vice City Theme; Everyone Checks Their Pastel Shirt Collection
stories.satire: Terry is delighted that it is top-down and eight-bit, and says he already owns the pixel suit for it, bought at full price in a shop that no longer exists. Reggie asks why a game that looks like it runs on a toaster needs a rig the size of a wardrobe. They argued over whether eight bits is a lot or not very many. Nobody wins, but the argument got a lot of exercise before lunch.
stories.real: Pure Xbox reports that Vice: Magic City Mayhem, a top-down eight-bit retro action game with a Vice City theme, is out on Xbox One and Series X|S. It is an Xbox and Epic Games Store exclusive for now, with the Steam, PS5 and Switch versions delayed.

link.text: Prefer your capers cat-sized? Try Grand Theft Kitty.

stories.headline: Video Game Scores Up For Grammys; Both Hosts Hum Different Tunes At The Same Time
stories.satire: Terry says his PC speakers are tuned to the finest pitch and will be hearing all five nominees tonight in full surround. Reggie says he hums the main theme while waiting for his updates, and that counts as being a fan. They argued over whether the hum is better with or without a download bar. Terry wins by humming louder, which is not how any of it works.
stories.real: Push Square reports that the nominees for the 2027 Grammy for Best Score Soundtrack For Video Games are Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora - From the Ashes, 007 First Light, Ghost of Yotei, Marvel's Wolverine and Star Wars Zero Company, and that it is only the fifth year the category has existed.

stories.headline: Four Free Hours Of A Big Game Offered; Reggie Declares It The Perfect Length
stories.satire: Reggie says four hours is an excellent amount, because it costs nothing and ends before the guilt begins. Terry says four hours is barely enough to open the settings menu and set his frame counter to a size he can show people. They argued over whether a trial is a taste or a tease. Reggie wins, since he is still playing the free bit and Terry has already bought two copies, just in case.
stories.real: Push Square reports that Remedy has made the first four hours of Control Resonant playable through PS Plus Premium as a Game Trial, and that the game is part of the PS Store Black Friday sale until 30 November, at 20% off, which is £39.99.

stories.headline: Fans Vote On A Robot Master Design; Cleanser Man Wins, Cupboards Under The Sink Rejoice
stories.satire: Terry says he voted the moment polls opened, on a PC with a very fast mouse, and is sure his entry was the best. Reggie says a robot called Cleanser Man is a bargain, because he can finally get a tidy kitchen without leaving the sofa. They argued over whether a boss with a mop is a boss or a cleaning contract. Terry loses, because his entry was a toaster with a laser.
stories.real: Push Square reports that Capcom picked Cleanser Man from six finalist designs in the Mega Man: Dual Override boss design contest, and that it becomes one of the game's eight boss characters, the fifth robot master announced with three still to come.

stories.headline: UK Download Records Broken Twice; Broadband Asked To Sit Down With A Cup Of Tea
stories.satire: Terry says he preloaded a week early, as is the custom of his people, and that his connection never even blinked, though his router was seen sweating. Reggie says he waited for the patches and then read a book, and that nobody counts a book as a download. They argued over what a record is when it is broken twice. Reggie wins, by pointing out that the router was working a lot harder than Terry was.
stories.real: Engadget's launch-day live blog reports that GTA 6 broke download records on the UK ISP Virgin Media twice, tied to the 12 November preload and the launch-night download of a 212 GB file plus patches.

stories.headline: Basketball Team's Game-Themed Merch Sells Out; Reggie Wonders If Doormats Are Next
stories.satire: Reggie spots a gap in the market for a tasteful tea towel and offers Terry a share, subject to an imaginary invoice for the idea. Terry says that real fans of the master race do not queue for jerseys, then asks, quietly, whether there is a size small. They argued over whether a jersey counts as a collector's edition. Terry wins, because it is the only argument he can have while holding a jersey.
stories.real: Kotaku's launch-day live blog reports that GTA-branded Miami Heat merchandise sold out in under 90 minutes, with Black Friday-style crowds trying to buy it.

stories.headline: Nominees Revealed For The Big Gaming Awards; Terry Clears A Space On The Mantelpiece
stories.satire: Terry says he has already prepared a speech and a mantelpiece, and neither belongs to him. Reggie says the best thing about an award show is that every nominated game goes on sale afterwards, and he has a calendar for it. They argued over whether being nominated counts as winning, or just as a very nice envelope. Reggie wins, since a calendar is hard to argue with.
stories.real: Nintendo Life reports that nominees were announced for The Game Awards, which take place on 10 December, with Ocarina of Time, Pokopia and Fire Emblem among Nintendo's nominations.

stories.headline: Retro Controllers Get A Black Friday Discount; Nostalgia Now Available In Double Packs
stories.satire: Reggie says a double controller pack is two chances to look generous while paying once, and that it is pound-for-pound the best bit of sales patter he has ever heard. Terry says he used a keyboard before it was cool, and that he will accept no controllers, then looks at the picture for some time. They argued over whether a thirty-five pound deal is cheap or just a smaller scare. Terry loses, on account of the picture.
stories.real: Nintendo Life reports that the full range of classic Nintendo Switch Online controllers is discounted on the European Nintendo Store for Black Friday, with the double NES controller pack listed at £34.99.

stories.headline: Cosy Tanuki Game Offers Fishing, Bug Catching And Pint Pouring; Weekend Plans Sorted
stories.satire: Terry says he would have the tanuki's whole day off him in nine hours, with a cheeky half-hour left over for fishing. Reggie says it is a nice little earner for a hat and a bicycle, and wonders if the pints come with a loyalty card. They argued over whether fishing in a game counts as a hobby or a rehearsal. Reggie wins, because Terry actually has a rod in the hall and has never caught anything.
stories.real: Push Square's mini review reports that Tanuki: Pon's Summer, released on PS5 on 10 November, has minigames including fishing, bug catching, pint pouring and sushi stacking, with the main story taking the reviewer about nine hours across 20 in-game days.

link.text: Fancy real-life fishing? Ferret's Ditch has the details.

stories.headline: Free Monster-Battling Game Gets A Balance Patch Next Month; Terry Prepares A Spreadsheet
stories.satire: Terry announces that he has already modelled every possible tweak, and the results fit on a single very smug slide. Reggie says a free game that gets patched for free is the only kind of subscription he can stomach. They argued over whether balance means fairness or a very small seesaw. Nobody wins, but the seesaw gets a good workout and Terry ends up sitting on the low end.
stories.real: Nintendo Life reports that Pokémon Champions, a free-to-play game on Switch and mobile, is getting a balance update on 2 December 2026, including move updates and adjustments to certain Pokémon.

editions.terry: And that, ladies and gentlemen, is Friday, and what a Friday! Everything in the big type is made up, the boxes are real, and I am off to check my router has had some water. Back tomorrow, and do wear something shiny!
editions.reggie: Check the boxes, my old son, that is where the facts live, and the rest is pure patter. The Pro is still on the wish-list and the sale is still a week away. Back tomorrow, and bring a bag.

editions.title: Everyone Updates Their Console; Terry Updates His Smugness
editions.standfirst: Terry (PC, Steam Deck, master race, full price on day one) and Reggie (PS5, saving for a Pro, waiting for the sale) read through the latest gaming news and argue about every bit of it. Everything in big type is made up, and so is the arguing. Everything in the boxes is real.

stories.headline: Console Asks For A Quick Update Before The Big Night; Reggie Already In His Coat
stories.satire: Reggie says he has been refreshing the update screen since breakfast and sends Terry an imaginary invoice for waiting up. Terry says his PC updated itself at three in the morning without a fuss, then admits he was awake at three in the morning refreshing it. They argued over whether a 1.3 gigabyte download counts as a quick one or a long one with a short bag. Reggie wins, on account of having his slippers on already.
stories.real: Push Square reports that Sony has confirmed PS5 system update v14.23.00, a download of about 1.3GB, is required to play GTA 6, and that players should install it before midnight on 19 November.

stories.headline: Pirate Game Packs Lighter For The Voyage; Hard Drives Offered A Few Gigabytes Back
stories.satire: Terry announces that his enormous drive was never short of room, and then lists everything he has uninstalled this week. Reggie says he is delighted to get his spare gigabytes back and will be selling them on, roughly nine of them, no questions asked. Terry points out that gigabytes cannot be resold. Reggie says that is what they said about the second-hand Pro. Terry wins this one, since the ship is lighter and Reggie's pitch is not.
stories.real: Push Square reports that a Sea of Thieves update due on 19 November makes the install up to 50% smaller on all platforms, cutting PS5 from about 102.7GB to 57.4GB, and that it forces a full reinstall. Pure Xbox reports Series X dropping from over 100GB to 56.4GB.

link.text: Short of hard drive? The Arcade fits in a browser tab.

stories.headline: Publisher Offers A Free Game To Anyone Who Films An Onion; Kitchens Brace For Auditions
stories.satire: Reggie has already found the onion, rehearsed his face, and is calling it a nice little earner for the price of one root vegetable. Terry says a true master-race gamer pays full price on release day and would never stoop to biting produce for a freebie. Reggie asks if that includes the Steam copy on offer. Terry goes quiet and checks the fridge. They argued about which of them would cry first. Reggie wins, on account of years of practice with the electric bill.
stories.real: VGC reports that Devolver Digital is giving away a Steam copy of Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed, which releases on the same day as GTA 6, to people who post a video of themselves deleting their GTA 6 pre-load, or biting an onion if they did not pre-order.

stories.headline: Fans Match A Fictional House To An Old Picture; Estate Agent Asked To Hold Please
stories.satire: Terry says he noticed the house years ago, which is a lie he tells with great confidence and a tea towel on his head. Reggie says he has been looking at that very house on his phone for weeks, and can offer a viewing at a generous rate. They argued over how many plants a house needs before it is definitely the same house. Terry wins, by naming every plant, then admitting he looked them up.
stories.real: VGC reports that players found a house in GTA 6 that closely matches an image in the 2021 Definitive Edition of GTA: San Andreas, which had been suspected to be an early look at the new game, and that the match was found by a fan mapping project.

link.text: Prefer your crimes cat-sized? Try Grand Theft Kitty.

stories.headline: Two Famous Games Share The Same Number; Calculators Asked To Stay Calm
stories.satire: Terry says a tie is a draw, a draw is a handshake, and a handshake is best done on a PC with the settings turned up. Reggie says a score of 99 will be a lot cheaper once it has been in the sale for a year. They argued over whether 134 and 22 are friends or just share a door number. Reggie wins, because Terry tried to explain the sums and his own fan started.
stories.real: Nintendo Life reports that GTA 6 had a Metacritic score of 99 from 134 reviews at the time of writing, matching the 99 held by Zelda: Ocarina of Time, which is based on 22 critic reviews.

stories.headline: Pixel Adventure Arrives Early On Two Stores; Other Doors Told To Wait
stories.satire: Terry is thrilled to learn the game is on a PC store, then sulks that it is the wrong one, having a Steam shelf of a size that needs planning permission. Reggie says his PS5 is happy to wait its turn, mostly because waiting costs nothing. They argued over whether being late is the same as being exclusive. Neither wins. Both spent the evening refreshing the same page and agreeing that it is a very small dungeon.
stories.real: Pure Xbox reports that Vice: Magic City Mayhem, an 8-bit top-down action adventure with a Vice City theme and Zelda-style play, is out on Xbox and the Epic Games Store, with the Steam, PS5 and Switch versions delayed.

stories.headline: National Park Simulator Reaches Consoles; Real Parks Nervously Check Their Opening Hours
stories.satire: Terry says his PC has had the park since March and he has seen every tree, though he has not played it since March. Reggie says he has booked a day out at no cost, packed a flask, and refuses to be responsible for the squirrels. They argued over whether a virtual picnic needs virtual sandwiches. Terry wins, because the sandwiches are very high resolution and Reggie's are in a tin.
stories.real: Pure Xbox reports that Ranger's Path: National Park Simulator launched on Xbox Series X|S, having been on PC since March, and that it is an Xbox Play Anywhere title.

link.text: Fancy a quieter patch of nature? Ferret's Ditch is open.

stories.headline: Blue Bomber Contest Crowns A Cleaning-Themed Boss; Mop Industry Delighted
stories.satire: Reggie sends Terry an invoice for professional consultancy on mops, bleach and the tidying of the whole boss arena. Terry says he cannot help noticing that the game is for the Switch and Switch 2, and asks where the PC version has got to. Reggie says Terry has a great many desktops and not one duster. They argued over whether a boss can be beaten with a very firm wipe. Terry wins, having already ordered the tea towel.
stories.real: Nintendo Life reports that Capcom named Cleanser Man the winner of the Robot Master design contest for Mega Man: Dual Override, which is due in spring 2027 on Switch and Switch 2, with the winning design to appear as a boss.

editions.terry: And that, ladies and gentlemen, is Thursday, and what a Thursday! Every word is made up apart from the boxes, which are real, and I have cleared a shelf for the lot. Back tomorrow, and do wear something shiny!
editions.reggie: Check the boxes, my old son, that is where the facts live, and the rest is a nice little earner. The Pro is still on the wish-list, and the sale is still only a few weeks off. Back tomorrow, and bring a bag.

editions.title: Gongs For Everyone; Reggie Brings A Bag For Life
editions.standfirst: Terry (PC, Steam Deck, master race, full price on day one) and Reggie (PS5, saving for a Pro, waiting for the sale) read through the latest gaming news and argue about every bit of it. Everything in big type is made up, and so is the arguing. Everything in the boxes is real.

stories.headline: Hyrule Remake Sells A Million Boxes In A Week; Shelves Asked To Budge Up
stories.satire: Reggie is delighted that so many people still like a box, and says he has always said physical was the future, having never once said so. Terry points out that a master-race PC has no box to put on a shelf, only a folder and a feeling. Reggie says folders do not gather dust, and that is exactly what is wrong with them. They argued over whether a million boxes would fit in the Steam Deck case. Terry wins, because nobody has ever tried.
stories.real: VGC reports Circana data showing the Switch 2 remake of Zelda: Ocarina of Time sold more than 1 million physical copies in its first week in the US, the first game to do that in a US launch week since Tears of the Kingdom in 2023.

stories.headline: Award Nominations Land; One Game Gets Eight, Everyone Else Gets Out The Good Suit
stories.satire: Terry has already written his acceptance speech for a game he has not been nominated for, on the grounds that he bought it on day one and that surely counts. Reggie says nominations are lovely but a trophy cannot be redeemed against a discount. Terry says the trophy is the discount. They argued over whether six Game of the Year contenders is a short list or a very polite queue. Reggie wins, having brought a flask.
stories.real: VGC reports that Grand Theft Auto VI leads The Game Awards 2026 with 8 nominations, Nintendo is the most-nominated publisher with 12, there are 27 categories with six Game of the Year nominees, and public voting runs until 9 December.

link.text: Prefer a caper with fewer nominations and more cats? Try Grand Theft Kitty.

stories.headline: Galactic Racers Told To Share The Sofa; Split-Screen Booked For Early Next Year
stories.satire: Reggie says split-screen is the finest idea in gaming, because it gets two players for the price of one console and he can see his opponent's screen. Terry says a master-race rig has several monitors and so has no use for squinting at half of one. Reggie replies that squinting builds character. They argued about who gets the top half. Reggie wins, since the top half is nearer the biscuits.
stories.real: VGC reports that Star Wars Galactic Racer is getting local split-screen multiplayer in early 2027, according to the game's official X account, plus a Free Play mode where players pick vehicle, character, planet and track and race with up to 3 others.

stories.headline: Phone Games Collect Their Gongs; Nobody Asked To Hold A Trophy While Walking
stories.satire: Terry congratulates the winners warmly, then says a phone is just a very small PC that has not yet realised its potential. Reggie says a game you can play on the bus, free, with a little jingle, is the most honest bargain in the industry. Terry wonders what the bus has done to deserve it. They argued over which one wins Best Pick Up and Play, then dropped it. Reggie takes this one, on a technicality involving the bus.
stories.real: PocketGamer.biz reports the Google Play Best of Play 2026 winners, with Arknights: Endfield named Best Game, Sea of Stars Best Story, Subway Surfers City Best Pick Up & Play, Warframe Best Multiplayer and Zenless Zone Zero Best Ongoing.

stories.headline: Garden Walking Game Gets Its Tunes Online; Phones Finally Allowed A Playlist
stories.satire: Reggie hums along happily, says a soundtrack you can listen to on a service you already pay for is a nice little earner, and sends himself a small invoice for the humming. Terry says a master-race PC has had a music folder since the dawn of time and has never once needed a category called Smart Device. Reggie says that is exactly the sort of thing a person says before losing the remote. They argued over the tempo. Terry wins by being slower.
stories.real: PocketGamer.biz reports that Nintendo Music added 27 Pikmin Bloom tracks, more than 40 minutes in total, making it the first mobile game on the service and the only title in a new Smart Device category.

stories.headline: Block Game Learns To Use A Mouse On A Handheld; Desk Declared Optional
stories.satire: Terry says a mouse is the sacred tool of his people and is slightly moved to see consoles borrowing it, like a stranger wearing his coat. Reggie says that for once he is with the handheld, because a mouse on your knee is the most comfortable way to build a house nobody asked for. Terry says it is only a matter of time before consoles ask for a keyboard. Reggie says he has already looked at one. They agreed to meet at a table. Nobody wins, but the table does well.
stories.real: Nintendo Life reports that Joy-Con 2 mouse controls are coming to the Switch 2 version of Minecraft in a future update and can already be tried in the closed beta, with no release date given.

stories.headline: Dungeon Crawler Books Its First Add-On For December; Calendars Quietly Rearranged
stories.satire: Terry will be waiting at the door on release day with his wallet out and a face like a man who has been told he is first in the queue, which he is. Reggie says an add-on is a lovely thing, once it has been in the sale for a good long while and a second one has been announced to take its place. Terry says that is how the master race gets ahead. Reggie says that is how the sale gets ahead. Reggie wins, and has cleared a space for Spring.
stories.real: Nintendo Life reports that Minecraft Dungeons II's first paid DLC, The Humblers Awaken, launches on 1 December 2026 alongside a bonus free update, and that a second DLC, Illusions of Grandeur, is slated for Spring 2027.

stories.headline: Inky Shooter Puts A Demo On The Shelf; Reggie Arrives Before It Has Finished Downloading
stories.satire: Reggie calls a free demo the finest product ever invented, being the only item he can pick up with no need to haggle. Terry says he does not do demos, as a person of taste buys the whole thing and then explains why to anyone nearby. Reggie says the demo has three stages and three loadouts, so he has already got more than Terry has said all week. They argued over the loadouts. Reggie wins, with a receipt for nothing.
stories.real: Nintendo Life reports that a Splatoon Raiders demo is on the Switch 2 eShop, offering three stages in the Spirhalite Islands and three preset loadouts.

link.text: Love a freebie? The arcade has plenty, and no one asks for a card.

stories.headline: Holiday Pop-Up Tours Ten Malls; Terry Wonders If The Atlantic Counts As A Queue
stories.satire: Terry has priced a flight, then a boat, then a very long walk, because a pop-up with free demos is a thing a man of his standing would simply have to attend. Reggie says the whole thing is in America, and he is not paying for a plane to get a gift tag. Terry says the gift tag is not the point. Reggie says it is a hundred points, which is a hundred more than he has. They agreed to ask for a Lancashire date. Terry wins on ambition, Reggie on mileage.
stories.real: Nintendo Life reports that Nintendo's Switch 2 Holiday Experience pop-up runs from 25 November to 23 December 2026 at ten US malls, with demos of Pokopia, Mario Kart World, Ocarina of Time and Splatoon Raiders, and a My Nintendo check-in that gives a gift tag set and 100 Platinum Points.

stories.headline: Store Sale Puts A Famous Remake At Eighty Per Cent Off; Reggie Seen Running
stories.satire: Reggie has not run since 1994, but he ran to the shop for this one, which he describes as the happiest day of his life since a cashback offer. Terry says he paid full price on day one and would do it again, ideally on a bigger screen. Reggie says that is the sound of a man missing the point by about sixty per cent. They argued about whether Gears of War: Reloaded at under ten dollars is a bargain or a miracle. Reggie wins, and has brought a bag for life.
stories.real: PlayStation LifeStyle reports that Final Fantasy VII Remake Digital Deluxe is 80% off at $11.99 on PS5 and Gears of War: Reloaded is $9.99, 75% off, in a PlayStation Black Friday promotion that the articles say runs until 1 December 2026.

stories.headline: Eight Old Favourites Move Into A Cheaper Tier; Nobody Dusts The Bear
stories.satire: Terry says every one of these is on his PC already, which he mentions loudly, and also that he has played the bear game three times, in three different resolutions. Reggie says a bear and a bird in a backpack are a national treasure and a nice little earner for anyone who waits. Terry says waiting is the enemy of the master race. Reggie says it is the enemy of the till. They argued over which game had the better hat. Nobody wins, and the bird keeps both.
stories.real: Pure Xbox reports that eight classic games, including Banjo-Kazooie, Perfect Dark and Viva Pinata, joined Xbox Game Pass Essential on 15 November for the Xbox 25th anniversary, and that this is the first time they have been available to Essential members.

stories.headline: Taxi Reboot Adds A Fifth Country; Reggie Offers To Take The Meter
stories.satire: Reggie is thrilled, because a cab with a meter is the closest thing gaming has to his own side of the business, and he is willing to run the meter for a modest fee. Terry says the game will look terrific at a frame rate that will make the console blush. Reggie says nobody blushes at a taxi, they pay it and look out of the window. They argued over whether a game can have a fare. Terry wins on style, Reggie on change.
stories.real: PlayStation LifeStyle reports that SEGA revealed an India map for Crazy Taxi: World Tour, the fifth location after West Coast, Germany, Brazil and Japan, for a 2027 release on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2 and PC.

stories.headline: Dog Adventure Gets A Year For Its Release; Whole Nation Offers To Hold The Lead
stories.satire: Terry has pre-ordered it on the strength of one picture of a dog, at full price, a year early, which he says is the finest form of loyalty. Reggie says a dog is the finest character in gaming because it asks for nothing but biscuits, and that is the only budget he can get behind. Terry says it will look glorious at a very high frame rate. Reggie says the dog will not mind. They agreed to share a biscuit. Reggie wins, and has already named the dog.
stories.real: PlayStation LifeStyle reports that Hounded, an adventure game told through the eyes of a loyal dog, is coming to PS5 and PC in 2027, with no exact release date announced.

link.text: Cat person? Grand Theft Kitty has you covered.

editions.terry: And that, ladies and gentlemen, is Wednesday! Every word made up apart from the boxes, which are real, and I have already ordered the dog. Back tomorrow, and do wear something shiny!
editions.reggie: Mind the boxes, my old son, that is where the facts live. Everything else is a nice little earner, and the sale is only ever a few weeks away. Back tomorrow, and keep the receipt.

editions.title: GTA Week Clears The Diary; Reggie Clears His Throat
editions.standfirst: Terry (PC, Steam Deck, master race, full price on day one) and Reggie (PS5, saving for a Pro, waiting for the sale) read through the latest gaming news and argue about every bit of it. Everything in big type is made up, and so is the arguing. Everything in the boxes is real.

stories.headline: Old Boot-Up Animations Return For A Birthday; Nation Switches On Just To Watch
stories.satire: Terry says a master-race PC does not need a startup animation, because it boots straight into a launcher and a sense of superiority. Reggie says that is the saddest thing he has ever heard, and that a console with a little welcome film is a console that cares. Terry admitted he has restarted his rig twice this morning in case it was feeling left out. Reggie wins, on sentiment, and has asked for a cake.
stories.real: Pure Xbox reports that three classic startup animations (the original Xbox one and two Xbox 360 ones, from 2005 and 2010) were added on Xbox One, Series X and Series S, timed to Xbox's 25th anniversary on 15 November.

stories.headline: Subscription Shelf Gets A Fresh Delivery; Reggie Calls It Free, Having Already Paid
stories.satire: Reggie is thrilled, since a game that arrives with the subscription is the closest thing to a sale that costs nothing extra. Terry says owning a game outright is the way of the master race, and renting is for people who cannot commit. Reggie says commitment is exactly why he has paid every month without fail, and would like that noted. They argued over whether a catalogue counts as a shelf. Reggie wins, since a shelf he does not have to dust is the best shelf of all.
stories.real: PlayStation LifeStyle says PS Plus Extra's November additions include Death Stranding 2: On the Beach, Atomfall and Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake, Premium adds Soul Reaver 2 and Freedom Wars Remastered, and some titles reach the US, UK and Japan on 24 November.

stories.headline: UK Chart Shuffles Like A Pack Of Cards; Top Spot Returns To Where It Started
stories.satire: Terry reads the chart aloud in his best chat-show voice and is hurt to find that his favourite game is not on it, because he bought it on Steam and the shops have never heard of him. Reggie says a game is only good value once it has left the chart and the price has wandered off. They argued about whether second place is a silver medal or a polite waiting room. Terry says silver. Reggie says waiting room, with a sale on the way. Nobody wins, and the pack is still two cards short.
stories.real: Nintendo Everything's report on the UK software chart for the week ending 14 November says EA Sports FC 27 returned to number one, Zelda: Ocarina of Time slipped from first to second, Football Manager 27 entered at number six and Halo: Campaign Evolved at number nine.

stories.headline: Release List Names Thursday The Big One; Other Days Asked To Wear Something Smaller
stories.satire: Terry has cleared his diary, his sofa and his fridge, then noticed the list only mentions PS5 and Xbox, and has gone quiet for the first time since 2011. Reggie has a PS5, so he is practically family, though he plans to play it once the price has dropped, which by his sums is some time around the next console generation. They argued over whether a launch day is a holiday. Reggie says bank, Terry says full price. Reggie wins on timing, Terry on enthusiasm.
stories.real: Instant Gaming's release list for 16 to 22 November puts Grand Theft Auto VI on 19 November for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and says it will overshadow the week's other releases.

link.text: Want a big day out with no queue and no pre-order? Try the arcade.

stories.headline: Basement Crawler Adds Four-Player Online Co-Op On Consoles; Friends Finally Allowed Downstairs
stories.satire: Terry has been playing online with friends for ages, and welcomes the consoles with the warm smile of someone arriving early to a party. Reggie says four players on one copy is the best bargain in gaming, provided the other three chip in, and has drawn up a seat-rental invoice for services rendered. Terry says nobody will pay it. Reggie says that is what they said about the sofa. Reggie wins, and has kept the downstairs for himself.
stories.real: Instant Gaming's release list says The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ Online arrives on 19 November on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and Switch 2, and adds online co-op for up to four players.

stories.headline: Fourth Paid Expansion Due Wednesday; Village Told To Tidy Up For Visitors
stories.satire: Terry will be there at the stroke of midnight, at full price, with a cup of tea and a very smug face. Reggie says a village with no rent, no rates and no energy bill is the finest property deal he has ever heard of, and wants to be mayor. They argued about whether cosy is a feeling or a price bracket. Terry wins this one, on the strength of having arrived first, though Reggie says he will be along in the sale and expects the best house to be gone.
stories.real: DLCompare's weekly release list says Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea, the game's fourth paid expansion, arrives on 18 November.

stories.headline: Three Release Dates Step Politely Aside; Calendar Asks For A Bigger Page
stories.satire: Terry says a delayed game is simply a game that has been given time to become even more worth his full price. Reggie says a delay is the finest news in gaming, since a later date means a later sale and a bigger saving, and he has gone to check what the discount might look like by 2027. They argued over who is waiting more patiently. For the first time ever the pair are waiting together, and Reggie wins, since he was already doing it.
stories.real: DLCompare's weekly list says Fable has moved to 23 February 2027, Squadron 42 to Q2 2027 and Danganronpa 2x2 to 14 January 2027, and ties the moves to GTA VI's 19 November launch.

stories.headline: Unicorn Game Lands On Six Platforms At Once; Both Of Them Technically Invited
stories.satire: Terry says the unicorn would obviously choose Steam, on the grounds that all magical creatures have excellent taste. Reggie says the unicorn would choose whichever version comes down in price first, and has been seen looking at a PS4 with great affection. They argued over which platform the horn looks best on. Neither is right, and the unicorn has reportedly gone home to think about it.
stories.real: DLCompare's weekly release list says Unicorn Academy: Island of Magic launches on 17 November on PS4, PS5, Switch, Steam, Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S.

editions.terry: And that, ladies and gentlemen, is Tuesday! Every word made up apart from the boxes, which are real, and arrived on release day at full price. Back tomorrow, and bring a bigger calendar!
editions.reggie: Mind the boxes, my old son, that is where the facts live. Everything else is a nice little earner, and a bargain only counts if you wait for it. Back tomorrow, and keep the receipt.

editions.title: Doom Gets A Horde Mode; Reggie Gets A Sale Notice
editions.standfirst: Terry (PC, Steam Deck, master race, full price on day one) and Reggie (PS5, saving for a Pro, waiting for the sale) read through the latest gaming news and argue about every bit of it. Everything in big type is made up, and so is the arguing. Everything in the boxes is real.

stories.headline: Free Horde Mode Arrives With Nineteen Arenas; Sofa Counted As A Twentieth
stories.satire: Reggie wants to know whether a mode counts as free if you have to own an expansion first. Terry says it absolutely does, because he has owned the expansion since the day it came out, at full price, and would like that noted in the minutes. Reggie says he will join the horde as soon as the expansion drops in a sale, and has promised to count the arenas twice to be sure. Terry wins this one, by the narrowest of margins and the widest of smiles.
stories.real: id Software's free horde mode for DOOM: The Dark Ages is due on 16 November for players who own the Revelations expansion, and its trailer shows 19 arenas.

stories.headline: Masked Mystery Character To Be Unmasked On 5 December; Nation Given Three Weeks To Guess Wrong
stories.satire: Terry has guessed already, at full price, with total confidence, and is certain the answer is somebody who owns a Steam Deck. Reggie has placed a bet too: nothing, on nobody, which he calls the only safe wager in gaming. They argued about whether guessing wrongly early is better than not guessing at all. Reggie wins, since he cannot possibly be wrong about a bet he has not made, and has asked for that to be written down.
stories.real: Epic says the identity of Fortnite's masked Captain X will be revealed at a live event on 5 December, which also closes the Treasure Hunters season. Epic has not confirmed any of the fan theories.

stories.headline: Deckbuilder Adds A New Character And Two Modes; The Cards Were Not Consulted
stories.satire: Terry says a card game is the natural habitat of the master race, because shuffling is basically overclocking. Reggie says he has played cards for years using a pack from a pub, which was free and has all fifty-two cards, give or take the three of clubs. They argued over whether a new character is a new friend or a new rival. Neither of them has a deck. Terry has a spreadsheet of one. Nobody wins, and the three of clubs is still missing.
stories.real: Slay the Spire 2's biggest update so far, version 0.113.0, reached the beta branch and adds a new playable character, two new game modes and many bug fixes, according to Instant Gaming.

stories.headline: Open-World Racer Heads For PS5 In January; Reggie Starts Practising Parking
stories.satire: Reggie is thrilled, and has reserved a space on the sofa for the occasion. Terry has been driving it since day one, at full price, and says he has seen everything in it twice. Reggie says that is perfect, because by the time the game reaches him in a sale it will be fully patched, fully explored and fully spoiled, which he calls a premium experience. Reggie wins. Terry has gone to look for a shortcut.
stories.real: A roadmap for Forza Horizon 6 says the game comes to PS5 in January 2027, with Series 8 and Series 9 content arriving before the end of 2026.

stories.headline: Adventurer Gets A Second Batch Of Boxes; Shelf Declared Limited, Like The Edition
stories.satire: Terry does not buy boxes. The master race keeps its shelves empty and its library enormous, and he finds a shelf full of cases rather quaint. Reggie loves a box, and likes the word limited even more, until he remembers that limited means paying promptly. They argued over who owns the console it fits. Neither of them does. Terry wins on shelf space, Reggie wins on dust, and the adventurer is still hanging off a ledge somewhere, waiting for a verdict.
stories.real: Limited Run Games announced a new batch of physical Switch 2 copies of Tomb Raider: Definitive Edition to mark the series' 30th anniversary, after the first batch sold out quickly.

stories.headline: Launch Day To Get A Twenty-Four-Hour Stream; Kettle Asked To Brace Itself
stories.satire: Terry will watch every minute on a second monitor and calls it multitasking. Reggie will watch the first ten minutes, a bit of the middle and the end, then catch up on the highlights, all for free, and wants it known that this is a very respectable way to buy a game. Terry says it is not buying anything. Reggie says exactly. Reggie wins on price, Terry wins on stamina, and the kettle has handed in its notice.
stories.real: YouTube's official channel will carry a 24-hour GTA VI stream starting at midnight on 19 November, with a pre-show from 11pm, according to Instant Gaming.

link.text: Fancy a big game that downloads in seconds? Try the arcade.

stories.headline: London Hands Out Twenty-Five Golden Joysticks; Nation's Mantelpiece Measured
stories.satire: Terry voted in every category and says the trophies ought to be handed straight to the PC. Reggie voted once, on the grounds that he is a man of principle and the voting was free, and has awarded himself a gold joystick for services to bargain hunting. He has raised an invoice for the engraving. Terry points out that a trophy in a Steam library cannot be dusted. Reggie says that is a selling point. Reggie wins, with a trophy that does not exist.
stories.real: The 44th Golden Joystick Awards took place in London with 25 awards in total, most chosen by fan vote and three by a panel of judges, according to Instant Gaming.

stories.headline: Game-Tracking Site Gets A Phone App; Backlog Now Available In Pocket Size
stories.satire: Terry's backlog lives on Steam, grows on release day and is, he says, an investment. Reggie's backlog is made entirely of sale bargains he has not yet opened, and he is quietly proud that every single one cost less than a sandwich. They argued about whose pile is bigger. A phone app can now settle it, which neither of them wants. Reggie wins, because his pile was cheaper, and Terry's has a lot more digits.
stories.real: Backloggd's mobile app entered closed beta on 13 November for Patreon members, Android first, with a public beta planned for spring 2027, according to Instant Gaming.

stories.headline: PS5 Gets A Smarter Picture Booster; Pro Wish-List Suddenly Feels Awkward
stories.satire: Reggie is delighted, since a free boost for his ordinary PS5 means one fewer reason to buy the Pro, and every reason he does not have is worth a pound. He has moved the Pro to the pending tray. Terry says the master race had sharp pixels years ago, from a box with a fan like a jet engine. Reggie says the sofa is quieter. Reggie wins, with wounded dignity intact, and Terry has gone quiet about frame rates.
stories.real: Sony's QSSR graphics enhancer is live in Marvel's Spider-Man 2 on the base PS5, and Push Square reports it is due to reach more games in the coming weeks.

stories.headline: Subscription Sale Starts Today For Two Weeks; Reggie Studies The Small Print Like A Treaty
stories.satire: Reggie signed up ages ago, which means the discount is not for him, and he has taken it very personally. He is considering leaving and rejoining as a brand new customer in a different hat. Terry says Steam has no subscription, so no catch, no small print and no hat. Reggie says Steam has sales too, and Terry has never once waited for one. A draw: the hat stays in the cupboard, and Reggie's dignity has been put on hold.
stories.real: Sony's PS Plus memberships go on sale from 16 November for two weeks, but the discounted prices apply only to new sign-ups, according to Push Square.

link.text: Want to see what a price looks like when it is free? Try the arcade.

stories.headline: Taxi Game Announces Fifth And Final Stop; Meter Left Running
stories.satire: Terry wants the final stop to be wherever his rig is, and expects a tip. Reggie has already sent the fare for all five stops in a single invoice, plus a small charge for the journey that has not happened yet, and calls it a nice little earner. Terry says nobody is paying, since the game is not due until next year. Reggie says that is why he is billing early. Reggie wins, on a technicality he has not explained.
stories.real: SEGA confirmed India as the fifth and final destination of Crazy Taxi: World Tour, joining the West Coast, Germany, Japan and Brazil, and Push Square says the game is due in 2027.

editions.terry: And that, ladies and gentlemen, is Monday! Every word made up apart from the boxes, which are real, and arrived on release day at full price. Back tomorrow, and bring a spare monitor!
editions.reggie: Check the boxes, my old son, that's where the truth lives. Everything else is a bargain, and a bargain is only a bargain if you wait for it. Back tomorrow, and mind the kettle.

editions.title: Zelda Sells Five Million; Cats Get A Simulator
editions.standfirst: Terry (PC, Steam Deck, master race, full price on day one) and Reggie (PS5, saving for a Pro, waiting for the sale) go through the last few days in gaming and argue about all of it. Everything in big type is made up, and so is the arguing. Everything in the boxes is real.
editions.terry: That's the gaming news, ladies and gentlemen! Every word made up apart from the boxes, which are real, and run beautifully at a locked 144 frames. Press start tomorrow morning, seven ish!
editions.reggie: Check the box underneath, my old son, that's where the truth lives. And if the arguing gets you down, wait a month and it'll be half price. My fee for refereeing is a tenner, payable in cash, no console required.

stories.headline: Hero Sells 5.2 Million Copies Before Anyone Has Found The Last Heart Piece
stories.satire: Terry says a handheld that plays everything is the only civilised way to celebrate, and wants it known that he bought it on day one, at full price, like a gentleman. Reggie is waiting for the sale and says five million people can't be wrong, only early. They argued about whether a master race is allowed to wait for a console to come down in price. Reggie raised an invoice for services as a silent hero. It is for a tenner, and it is silent too.
stories.real: Nintendo said the Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake sold more than 5.2 million copies worldwide in its first four days on Switch 2 after its 5 November launch, which it says is the fastest start for any game it has published on the console.

stories.headline: Fourteen Games Launch In One Day; Nation Can Now Be A Cat, A Banker Or A Cleaner
stories.satire: Terry bought all fourteen on release day, on Steam, at full price, and is now a cat with a very high spec. Reggie is holding out for seventy per cent off and has put the banker on his PS5 wishlist until further notice. They argued over who gets the house cleaner, and Terry said it runs at a smoother frame rate on a proper rig. Reggie said a smoother frame rate does not make the washing up any drier.
stories.real: PureXbox counted 14 games launching on Xbox on 13 November, including Cat Simulator, Banker Simulator and House Cleaner Simulator.

link.text: Want a cat game with tricycles and a promenade full of Dreamies? Play Grand Theft Kitty.

stories.headline: Third Instalment Confirmed 'In Production'; Production Confirmed To Be Where Games Come From
stories.satire: Terry has pre-ordered a game that does not exist yet, at full price, on the strength of the number three alone. Reggie says he will pick it up in about 2029, in a sale, for the price of a sausage roll, and will be perfectly happy. They argued over which of them gets the better deal: the early adopter who pays the most, or the man who gets the game after everyone else has found all the secrets. Nobody has checked the date. The studio has not been consulted.
stories.real: Game Informer reported on 13 November that Wolfenstein 3 is officially in production.

stories.headline: God Of War Spin-Off Heads For The PS4; The Console Is Thrilled To Be Asked
stories.satire: Reggie is delighted. His PS5 is waiting for a Pro it cannot afford, so a spin-off arriving on the old PS4 in the loft feels like a very small win, and he has gone up with a torch. Terry says the master race do not look backwards and has asked, once more, what a PS4 is. They argued about whether a console in a loft counts as retired or resting. Reggie says resting, and that he will wait for the price of the PS4 to go down a bit more.
stories.real: Instant Gaming reported on 13 November that the Metroidvania spin-off God of War: Sons of Sparta will get a free content update and launch on PS4 on 16 November.

stories.headline: Halo Remake Gets Firefight Mode; Terry Insists On Being The Fire
stories.satire: Terry says he will be the Fire, and has bought a headset for the occasion, at full price, to hear it properly. Reggie says that makes him the Fight, and he will join in as soon as the new mode comes down in a sale. They argued for forty minutes about whether a game that plays better on a rig beats a game that plays slightly worse on a sofa with a biscuit. Somebody pointed out that the mode is for several players, and the two of them are on the same sofa.
stories.real: Instant Gaming reported on 13 November that Halo: Campaign Evolved, the remake of the first Halo's story, is getting a new mode called Firefight.

stories.headline: Golden Trophies Await; Nominees Told To Look Casual Until Tuesday
stories.satire: Terry has written four acceptance speeches, bought a bow tie at full price and says the master race expects to take the lot. Reggie has put himself forward for Best Supporting Invoice and expects to be unopposed, with a bargain bundle thrown in. They argued about who thanks whom first, and agreed to thank the cats, who were not consulted. Nominees have until Tuesday to practise a face for losing graciously. Terry is practising on a very good webcam.
stories.real: Final Weapon reported on 14 November that the Game Awards 2026 nominees will be announced in a live stream on 17 November, with the ceremony itself on 10 December.

stories.headline: Boxed Edition Contains A Code, Not A Disc; Nation Opens Box, Finds Slightly Fancier Receipt
stories.satire: Terry opened the box and found a card with a code on it, and has now installed the pre-load, which has eaten most of his storage. He says the master race can take a few hundred gigabytes on the chin. Reggie is delighted: a smart box with nothing in it is the oldest trick going, and he will wait for the discount, thank you very much. They argued over whether a box counts as part of the game. Reggie has put a bid in for all the empty ones.
stories.real: A roundup of Rockstar's Newswire post of 10 November says boxed copies of GTA VI, due in shops from 12 November, contain a download code rather than a disc, and that the pre-load needs up to 212 GB of space.

link.text: Our games need no box, no code and no 212GB. Visit the arcade.

stories.headline: Ten Games In Twelve Years, Then Thirteen Years For The Next; Maths Teacher Applauds
stories.satire: Terry bought every one of the ten on release day, at full price, and says the master race has been paying for the privilege since Vice City. Reggie has been waiting for a sale for thirteen years and believes it is nearly due. They argued over whether paying the most is a hobby or a medical condition. Reggie thinks it is the only business where the longer the customer waits, the more they thank you, and he intends to try it with his rent. The calendar has not commented.
stories.real: GamesRadar noted on 14 November that Rockstar released the first ten Grand Theft Auto games in just twelve years, as the 13-year wait for GTA 6 comes to an end.

stories.headline: Parcel-Delivery Game Joins Subscription Library; Nation Told To Take Its Time
stories.satire: Reggie is thrilled, because a game that arrives free with a subscription is the best sale there is, and has booked himself a whole weekend of it. Terry says the master race would rather pay full price than borrow a thing from a library, and has bought a second copy to be safe. They argued about who carries the heavy parcel. Terry has a very good chair. Reggie has a very good excuse. The cat has gone on ahead with the small one.
stories.real: Fandomwire reported on 14 November that PlayStation's November Game Catalog additions include the PS5 game Death Stranding 2: On the Beach, arriving on 17 November.

stories.headline: Minigame Loses Certain Words; Minigame Asks Which Ones
stories.satire: Terry typed a word to see if it had gone, on a keyboard that lights up in nine colours, and was refused in all nine. Reggie typed it on a controller, one letter at a time, and was refused at a much more dignified pace. They argued about which of them had written the worst word and agreed it was the one Terry will not repeat. Reggie wants it noted that a bargain keyboard from a car boot would have been refused too, and for a good deal less.
stories.real: GamesRadar reported on 14 November that Final Fantasy 14 patched certain words out of Keyboard Brawler, a limited-time minigame in the game.
